a.lede: Electric cars need incredibly large batteries that offer long driving ranges and charge quickly, but remain cool when under load. This is how they do so.
a.title: What kind of cooling system do EV batteries use and how does it work?

b.lede: Electric vehicles lose battery when they're left unused for long periods. There are a number of reasons why, and some might be totally out of your control.
b.title: Why your EV battery still loses charge while it's parked
